query: Marvell carrier infrastructure and enterprise networking revenue
normalized: carrier enterprise infrastructure marvell networking revenue

output.content:
Marvell’s last separately reported end-market revenue was in **Q3 FY2026** (three months ended November 1, 2025): **enterprise networking revenue was $237.2 million** and **carrier-infrastructure revenue was $167.8 million**. [[1]] 

Those amounts represented **11%** and **8%**, respectively, of Marvell’s $2.075 billion total quarterly revenue. [[1]] 

Versus Q3 FY2025, enterprise networking rose **57%** from $150.9 million, while carrier infrastructure rose **98%** from $84.7 million. [[1]] 

Marvell began combining enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, consumer, and automotive/industrial into a single **“communications and other”** end market beginning in Q4 FY2026, so subsequent filings do not provide the two requested revenue figures separately. [[1]] 

For context, in the latest reported quarter, Q2 FY2027 ended August 1, 2026, Communications and other revenue was **$567.8 million**, up 10% year over year and down 3% sequentially; this is not directly comparable to the former two-category sum because it includes the additional end markets. [[2]]
